services.name: Kitchen Countertops
services.summary: Marble, granite, and quartz countertops templated, fabricated, and installed.
services.description: We template the job on site, fabricate to your slab layout, and set the tops with the seams and overhangs where they belong. Edge profiles, undermount sink cutouts, cooktop cutouts, and backsplash to match.
bullets: Marble, granite, quartzite, and engineered quartz
Eased, bullnose, ogee, mitered, and waterfall edges

services.name: Bathroom Vanities & Showers
services.summary: Vanity tops, shower surrounds, curbs, niches, and benches in stone and tile.
services.description: Full bathroom stone and tile work — vanity tops with integrated or undermount basins, tiled shower walls and pans, waterproofed curbs, recessed niches, and built-in benches.
bullets: Steam showers and full wet rooms

services.name: Backsplashes
services.summary: Subway, mosaic, slab, and hand-made tile set clean and level.
services.description: The detail people look at every day. Layouts planned around outlets and windows, cuts kept off the sightlines, and grout joints that stay consistent from end to end.

services.name: Floor & Wall Tile
services.summary: Porcelain, ceramic, and natural stone tile for floors and walls.
services.description: Substrate prep, crack isolation, and heated-floor systems where they make sense — because tile fails from what is under it far more often than from the tile itself.

services.name: Custom Fabrication
services.summary: Fireplace surrounds, hearths, thresholds, window sills, and one-off pieces.
services.description: Cut-to-size stone for the pieces that do not come off a shelf — mantels and surrounds, saddles and thresholds, sills, shelving, table tops, and bar tops.

services.name: Outdoor Stone & Pool Coping
services.summary: Patios, pool coping, and outdoor kitchens built for East End winters.
services.description: Freeze-thaw on the East End is hard on outdoor stone. We spec and set material that handles it — bluestone and travertine patios, pool coping and waterline tile, and outdoor kitchen tops.

differentiators.title: One shop, start to finish
differentiators.body: Template, fabrication, and installation are the same crew. Nothing gets lost in a handoff between a fabricator and an installer who have never met.

differentiators.title: We work on the East End
differentiators.body: Local to Hampton Bays. That means real timelines on a Hamptons job calendar, and someone who picks up the phone after the install.

differentiators.title: Straight estimates
differentiators.body: A written estimate with the material, the square footage, and the labor broken out — so you can see what you are paying for before anyone cuts a slab.

faq.a: We are based in Hampton Bays and work across the South Fork and North Fork — Southampton, Westhampton, Quogue, Bridgehampton, Sag Harbor, East Hampton, Montauk, Riverhead, and the surrounding hamlets.

faq.q: Do you supply the stone, or can I bring my own slab?
faq.a: Either. We can walk the slab yards with you and help you pick material, or fabricate and install a slab you have already bought.

faq.q: How long does a countertop job take?
faq.a: Typically about one to two weeks from template to install, depending on material availability. We give you the schedule in writing with the estimate.

faq.q: What is the difference between marble, quartzite, and quartz?
faq.a: Marble is a natural stone that etches with acid and patinas over time — beautiful, but it asks something of you. Quartzite is natural and much harder, so it resists etching and scratching. Quartz is engineered and non-porous, which makes it the lowest-maintenance of the three. We will walk you through the tradeoffs for how you actually use your kitchen.
Yes. Send through the form on the contact page or call, and we will set up a time to look at the job.
